description: Originally published as Classics Illustrated no.139.

Life begins in a tranquil corner of the Santa Clara valley for Buck, a domesticated dog on a picturesque ranch. Llife turns upside down for him when he is abducted and sold to an Alaskan Dog Sled team. Now he must survive in the harshest climate on Earth and bond with a team of hounds he's never known.

Is a man a monster by birth or can he stitch himself into something more? This illustrated masterpiece dives deep into the machinations of one doctor who sought to create life from death and the fruits of his labors that discovers the monster within every man. Read one of the most startling tales you'll ever behold as Mary Shelley's great tale comes to life within these very pages!
Griffin arrives in Iping during a snowstorm. He may be surly, defensive, and odd, but there is something even more astonishing about him that you'll never see.

It's 1790, The American Revolutionary War has drawn to a close and life moves on in a brave new country. But Ichabod Crane is an awkward schoolmaster who becomes the focus of a terrible plot that may tear the Dutch village of Tarry Town apart. What secrets lie in the Sleepy Hollow and are they all at rest?
A man imbibes a potion that makes him something else. Can he overcome his base nature to compose himself and reclaim his nobility? Read on to find out!

Harvey Cheyne Jr was born in sunny San Diego, California and is the son of a wealthy railroad magnate. As a boy, he enjoyed the considerable comforts of his father's success, now he must survive in the North Atlantic with the crew of a humble fishing boat and become a man. Can Charlie overcome years of privilege to survive on the open seas?

It's 1745 and two brothers of Scottish nobility face a terrible strain upon their family in the midst of the Jacobite uprising. Will their relationship survive? Can hope live when you're in exile?

This triumph of literature explores just how far men will go in search of power and honor.
George Eliot's masterful tale of a linen weaver and the human toll exacted upon society by industrialization. Who lives? who dies? Find out inside!
Love, loss and a return so powerful, you'll cry yourself to sleep. Emily Bronte's literary classic Wuthering Heights comes to life in the pages of Classics Illustrated.
Would-be knight Don Quixote embarks on a quest with his faithful sidekick Sancho to fight giants, armies, and threats of the land. But are all of Don Quixote's noble deeds real or just imagined?
